original_test_intent: Validate TEMP_GB_GPU1 through TEMP_GB_GPU8 as eight GPU-related thermal channels, with correct physical GPU/module identity and sensing meaning consistently represented in complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web evidence.
original_method: The platform owner defines GB, maps GPU1–GPU8 to fitted module serials/slots/BDFs and sensor sources, provides operating-condition limits, and automation passively collects every exact record across all source-required paths.
manual_activity: The platform/thermal owner defines GB, binds all eight indices to fitted GPU modules and sensing points, approves thresholds and Web entries. No workload, GPU reset, fan action or log clear is authorized.
required_inputs: Authoritative GB meaning and board/revision topology
GPU1–GPU8 physical slot/module serial/UUID/BDF and fitted-state map
Sensor source as GPU junction, board probe, controller estimate or derived value
Exact SDR entity/name/description and Sensor List/Web mapping per member
Units, scale, tolerance, sampling/freshness and unavailable semantics
Approved limits and enabled thresholds under documented workload, power, cooling and ambient state
Same-target IB/OOB identity plus BMC/SDR/GPU/board firmware/spec revisions
Secret-safe complete collectors and independent GPU/thermal/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Bind exact row 1869 and never execute the duplicate DIMM workflow for this case
Enumerate GPU1 through GPU8 separately; the tilde label is not one sensor
Bind each reading to GPU serial/UUID/BDF and explicit sensor source
Retain complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List before filters; collect Web evidence
Do not start workload, reset GPU, change power/fans/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on population mismatch, missing/stale/invalid data, unsafe temperature, XID/link/thermal fault or path mismatch; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact row/variant, GB/GPU topology and same-target IB/OOB identity
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus eight exact mapped records
Prepare Web parity and passive GPU/XID/power/fan/SEL context
Perform no DIMM query as substitute, workload, GPU/fan/threshold action or verdict
engineer_actions: Define GB and approve GPU-to-sensor mapping/source semantics
Confirm Web mappings and unpopulated handling
Review all eight channels with passive GPU context and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

review_improvement: Quarantines the DIMM variant, adds GPU serial/BDF and sensing-source provenance, restores all IB/OOB/Web views and prevents UBB evidence substitution.
independent_technical_reasoning: The same code names unrelated DIMM and GPU workflows, so row identity is essential. Within the GPU row, a label may expose junction telemetry or a board-adjacent probe; those have different thermal dynamics and limits. Stable module serial/UUID/BDF mapping is required because GPU enumeration and service replacement can reorder indices.
